description: The 9 valid Workday payment terms — the list the Customer EIB's own drop-down validates Customer Payment!C against. The EIB carries a Ref ID per term and it does NOT match the display value (and is inconsistently cased: NET_21 but Net_7). The accepted upload writes the DISPLAY value ('Net 30'), so that is what the template offers; reference_id is recorded for traceability only.
provenance: Transcribed 2026-07-15 from the Customer EIB's Payment_Term named range ('Customer Specific Named Ranges'!E2, FA E2E Customers V1.xlsm). A snapshot, not a link. NOT the migration's 5 distinct output values — Net 21, EOM + 30 Days, Net 14 and Immediate are valid but appear on zero migrated rows.
